_note: Tier 2, oldest end of the corpus, December 2023. Worker taking --until 2023-12-31 to stay clear of the other worker on the newest end.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing a man in the Oval Office with his hands to his head, weeping and crying out for mercy over America and interceding, and says this is another thing to pray over.
mentions.quote: he was crying and asking for Mercy concerning America
mentions.falsify_match: A president reported praying and weeping for mercy over the nation in the Oval Office.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such account. The man is not named and no date is given, so almost any future report would fit.

mentions.claim_text: He describes pastors gathered praying and interceding for the nation with tears, in the same White House scene.
mentions.quote: I could see the pastures and they were interceding in there
mentions.falsify_match: Pastors praying in the White House, which is reported when it happens.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such gathering. Note pastors have prayed in the White House under successive administrations, so the base rate is high.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as the prayer went on in the White House the land pulsed with shocks rippling across it and a thick black energy began to move across the soil of America, and then he was shown something up toward the North Pole.
mentions.quote: waves of energy moving across the soil of America
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: energy moving over the soil in the spirit has no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: Citing the humbling and turning condition, he says he believes God is giving America more time, wants a major revival, and desires an outpouring of the Spirit on America and the earth greater than has been seen.
mentions.quote: I believe he's giving us more time here
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable national revival in America.
mentions.falsify_miss: None comes. He marks it as what he believes rather than as a word, and the condition attached removes any deadline.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching on dying to self and on treasure in earthen vessels, noting that people relocate readily for secular work such as selling insurance.
mentions.quote: We have a treasure and an earthen vessel
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: exposition on 2 Corinthians 4 and personal cost, with no forward statement.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces the session as a warning that a major shift and a major shaking is about to take place worldwide rather than only in America, calls it a worldwide wake-up, and makes an altar call.
mentions.quote: a major shaking is about to take place in this world
mentions.falsify_match: A worldwide upheaval identifiable as the shaking described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No content, no measure and no date, so nothing could register as a miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says the kingdoms of the world see how weak the president and his administration are from the defence and state secretaries down, that America is in peril unless something happens quickly, and that he saw tens of millions of people coming from Mexico.
mentions.quote: I saw tens of millions of people coming from the Mexico
mentions.falsify_match: Tens of millions crossing the southern border.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing on that scale. Total southwest border encounters across the whole Biden term were about 10 million, so tens of millions is an order of magnitude above what occurred.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that a great earthquake in the Bible means magnitude 6.0 or above, that an earthquake heralded the resurrection, and introducing the four sins scripture says defile the land.
mentions.quote: you know what a great earthquake is 6.0 or above
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: scriptural exposition. The gloss is also his own, since the Bible gives no magnitudes.

mentions.claim_text: Reading the curses of Deuteronomy 28 on rain turned to powder and dust, and recounting the three years without rain under Elijah as judgment on Baal worship.
mentions.quote: he'll change it to powder and dust from the heaven
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: he is reading scripture aloud.

mentions.claim_text: Reading the account of Cain and Abel and drawing out the question of whether he is his brother's keeper.
mentions.quote: Cain rose up against Abel and slew him
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: he is reading Genesis 4 aloud.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are leaving California and settling in Texas, Arizona and along the Gulf Coast because the earth is vomiting them out over the shedding of innocent blood, and that the cities are venting out their inhabitants.
mentions.quote: they're leaving California the Earth is vomiting them out
mentions.falsify_match: Continued net outmigration from California to Texas, Arizona and the Gulf states.
mentions.falsify_miss: The flow reverses. Note this was already the established and widely reported pattern when he said it, so the observation carried no risk.

mentions.claim_text: He says America must not forget its Judeo-Christian foundation and the covenants made with God at its founding, citing the Declaration of Independence and the Liberty Bell, and warns that forgetting God means the land spews its people out.
mentions.quote: America must not forget the judeo-christian foundation
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: an argument about national founding and covenant.

mentions.claim_text: Reading the Abrahamic land grant from the Nile to the Euphrates and observing that it takes in Jordan, parts of Iraq and Syria and parts of Saudi Arabia, land he says Israel has not yet received.
mentions.quote: from the river of Nile into the Euphrates River
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim as given: scriptural exposition with a map, and no statement that the borders will change by a date.

mentions.claim_text: Reading Ezekiel 38 on the coalition that comes with Gog against Israel, naming Iran and Persia among them, and the earthquake that follows in the land of Israel.
mentions.quote: that comes with Russia against Israel is Iran Persia
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: he is reading Ezekiel 38 aloud and identifying Rosh with Russia, which is his interpretation and not the text.

mentions.claim_text: Continuing to read Ezekiel 38 on the earthquake in the land of Israel, everything on the earth shaking at God's presence, mountains thrown down and every wall falling.
mentions.quote: there will be an earthquake in the land of Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: continued scripture reading.

mentions.claim_text: Continuing the same Ezekiel passage on all nations seeing it, the mountains thrown down and every wall falling when God stands up to defend Israel.
mentions.quote: all the nations will see it and will shake at my presence
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: continued scripture reading.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a new currency and a new petrodollar being brought in, that the United States had a plan to counter it and was not caught off guard, and that he saw the Federal Reserve chair sweating and worried.
mentions.quote: I saw Jerome Powell he was sweating on his face
mentions.falsify_match: A rival currency or petrodollar arrangement launched, with a visible US counter-plan.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such launch. BRICS currency talk was already public when he said this, and no common currency has been issued.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a figure given a Solomon-like endowment of wisdom, gathering the pieces of something destroyed the way an architect rebuilds a wrecked rocket ship, trying to build America back.
mentions.quote: trying to build back America great again through a Solomon type of an anointing
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: an anointing of wisdom on an unnamed figure has no observable test.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying America will never be what it was before but will be something new and different, rebuilt but not as good as it was, and that the days that were before are over.
mentions.quote: America will never be what it was before
mentions.falsify_match: A permanent, visible step down in American standing.
mentions.falsify_miss: America returns to its former position. Undated and without a measure, so it can be carried indefinitely.

mentions.claim_text: He says voices were pacifying people with assurances that everything would be good and all things work together for good, speaking the word but not what was on God's heart, and not speaking things that would make hearers grow.
mentions.quote: everything is going to be good but they were not speaking what God was on God's heart
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a judgment about other preachers' motives with no test attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says gold will rise, and reports being told to focus on the giant sequoia in California, whose seed does not open until fire comes upon it, and that believers will be like the sequoia rooting deep, with a fire coming upon the land.
mentions.quote: the gold will rise and then he said I want you to focus
mentions.falsify_match: Gold rises. It did, from about 2,000 dollars in December 2023 to a record above 5,600 in January 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Gold falls. Note there is no target, no date and no magnitude, and gold rises in most years, so the bar is low.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great shaking is coming and warns against the assumption that it is about America, pointing out that America is not even ten percent of the world's population and that the whole world will shake.
mentions.quote: the world is going to shake the world is going to shake
mentions.falsify_match: A worldwide upheaval identifiable as the shaking.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated and unmeasured. The demographic point is roughly right: America is about 4 percent of world population.
